_comment: editorconfig-checker — https://editorconfig-checker.github.io. Focused on YAML / JSON / TOML / shell scripts. Excluded by design: Go (gofumpt + golangci-lint enforce tab indent), Markdown (markdownlint covers it, plus fenced code blocks trip false positives), and Makefile (multi-line shell-script recipes with tab+space continuation are an established Makefile convention).

Disable._IndentSize_comment: Markdown lists use 3-space continuation past the bullet — correct markdown but conflicts with strict indent_size=2. Trailing-whitespace and EOL checks still catch real bugs.
Disable._MaxLineLength_comment: Line-length lives in .markdownlint.json and .yamllint.yml instead, so editorconfig-checker doesn't need to police it.
